import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.PicEtAffTensorStageDescentClass
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.PicEtAffZariskiGlue
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.PicEtTensorStageFlatten

/-!
# Mapping finite tensor-stage descent classes back to the ambient test

The descent class constructed on a nested finite tensor stage represents the original
etale-plus Picard class after restriction to the ambient tensor algebra.  This file records
that comparison first over the intermediate field, where all carrier maps are canonical.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory
open scoped TensorProduct

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

noncomputable section

namespace DatG0

set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 16 in
/-- The nested tensor-stage map as an algebra map over the intermediate field. -/
noncomputable def tensorStageNestedAmbientMapOverIntermediate
    {F K B : Type u} [Field F] [Field K] [Algebra F K]
    [CommRing B] [Algebra F B]
    (M : FinSubext F K) (S : FiniteStageData M.1 K) :
    S.stage ⊗[M.1] (M.1 ⊗[F] B) →ₐ[M.1] K ⊗[F] B :=
  ((Algebra.TensorProduct.cancelBaseChange F M.1 K K B).toAlgHom.restrictScalars M.1).comp
    (S.tensorMap (A := M.1 ⊗[F] B))

end DatG0

set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 100000 in
-- The canonical specialization combines two finite-stage tensor towers and both overlap faces.
set_option maxHeartbeats 2400000 in
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 16 in
/-- Canonical finite-stage descent of an ambient etale descent class.

The ambient cover is kept over `K tensor[F] B`, exactly as produced by
`exists_finSubext_baseChanged_tensorStage_cover_representation`.  Its relative Picard class
is transported to the normalized carrier `K tensor[M] E₀.Carrier`; a
`RelPicTensorStageData` for that class then supplies the lower class. -/
noncomputable def descentClassOfTensorStageData
    {F K B : Type u} [Field F] [Field K] [Algebra F K]
    [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F K] [CommRing B] [Algebra F B]
    (M : DatG0.FinSubext F K)
    {C : Over (Spec (.of M.1))} (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 M.1) [IsAffineHom pi]
    [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    [GeometricallyReduced C.hom] :
    let R := M.1 ⊗[F] B
    let TK := K ⊗[F] B
    let iota : R →ₐ[F] TK :=
      Algebra.TensorProduct.map M.1.val (AlgHom.id F B)
    letI : Algebra M.1 K := IntermediateField.toAlgebra M.1
    letI : Algebra M.1 R := Algebra.TensorProduct.leftAlgebra
    letI : Algebra M.1 TK := Algebra.TensorProduct.leftAlgebra
    letI : Algebra R TK := iota.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    ∀ (E₀ : Algebra.EtaleCover R)
      letI : IsScalarTower M.1 K (E₀.baseChange TK).Carrier :=
        IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (fun _ => rfl)
      (ξK : descentClasses C (E₀.baseChange TK))
      (D : RelPicTensorStageData pi
        (relPicAlgMap C
          ((DatG0.etaleCoverTensorStageCarrierEquiv M E₀).toAlgHom.restrictScalars M.1)
          ξK)),
      let TS := D.stage.stage ⊗[M.1] R
      letI : CommRing TS := Algebra.TensorProduct.instCommRing
      letI : Algebra M.1 TS := Algebra.TensorProduct.instAlgebra
      letI : Algebra R TS := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
      descentClasses C (E₀.baseChange TS) := by
  dsimp only
  let iota : M.1 ⊗[F] B →ₐ[F] K ⊗[F] B :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.map M.1.val (AlgHom.id F B)
  letI : Algebra M.1 K := IntermediateField.toAlgebra M.1
  letI : Algebra M.1 (M.1 ⊗[F] B) := Algebra.TensorProduct.leftAlgebra
  letI : Algebra M.1 (K ⊗[F] B) := Algebra.TensorProduct.leftAlgebra
  letI : Algebra (M.1 ⊗[F] B) (K ⊗[F] B) :=
    iota.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  intro E₀ ξK D
  letI : IsScalarTower M.1 K (E₀.baseChange (K ⊗[F] B)).Carrier :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (fun _ => rfl)
  letI : CommRing (D.stage.stage ⊗[M.1] (M.1 ⊗[F] B)) :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.instCommRing
  letI : Algebra M.1 (D.stage.stage ⊗[M.1] (M.1 ⊗[F] B)) :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.instAlgebra
  letI : Algebra (M.1 ⊗[F] B)
      (D.stage.stage ⊗[M.1] (M.1 ⊗[F] B)) :=
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight
      (R := M.1) (A := D.stage.stage) (B := M.1 ⊗[F] B)).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra D.stage.stage
      (D.stage.stage ⊗[M.1] (M.1 ⊗[F] B)) :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.leftAlgebra
  letI : IsScalarTower M.1 D.stage.stage
      (D.stage.stage ⊗[M.1] (M.1 ⊗[F] B)) := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.algebraMap_def, Algebra.TensorProduct.algebraMap_def,
      RingHom.comp_assoc, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq]
  letI : IsScalarTower M.1 (M.1 ⊗[F] B)
      (D.stage.stage ⊗[M.1] (M.1 ⊗[F] B)) := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
    ext r
    change (algebraMap M.1 D.stage.stage r) ⊗ₜ[M.1] (1 : M.1 ⊗[F] B) =
      (1 : D.stage.stage) ⊗ₜ[M.1] (algebraMap M.1 (M.1 ⊗[F] B) r)
    exact Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_one_eq_one_tmul r
  let hpush : Algebra.IsPushout M.1 (M.1 ⊗[F] B) D.stage.stage
      (D.stage.stage ⊗[M.1] (M.1 ⊗[F] B)) := TensorProduct.isPushout'
  letI : Algebra.IsPushout M.1 D.stage.stage (M.1 ⊗[F] B)
      (D.stage.stage ⊗[M.1] (M.1 ⊗[F] B)) :=
    (Algebra.IsPushout.comm M.1 D.stage.stage (M.1 ⊗[F] B)
      (D.stage.stage ⊗[M.1] (M.1 ⊗[F] B))).mpr hpush
  let ambient : CompatibleAmbientDescentData
      (S := D.stage.stage) (R := M.1 ⊗[F] B)
      (TS := D.stage.stage ⊗[M.1] (M.1 ⊗[F] B)) (TK := K ⊗[F] B) C E₀ :=
    { qStage := D.qStage
      ξK := ξK
      jA := tensorStageDataCarrierMap (B := B) M E₀ D.stage
      jQ := tensorStageDataOverlapMap (B := B) M E₀ D.stage
      hjQ := tensorStageData_overlapMap_injective (B := B) M C E₀ D.stage
      map_eq := tensorStageData_map_eq (B := B) M pi E₀ ξK D
      faceLeft_eq := tensorStageData_faceLeft (B := B) M E₀ D.stage
      faceRight_eq := tensorStageData_faceRight (B := B) M E₀ D.stage }
  exact descentClassOfCompatibleAmbient
    (k := M.1) (S := D.stage.stage) (R := M.1 ⊗[F] B)
    (TS := D.stage.stage ⊗[M.1] (M.1 ⊗[F] B)) (TK := K ⊗[F] B)
    C E₀ ambient

private theorem tensorProductPushoutEquiv_self
    {M S R : Type u} [CommRing M] [CommRing S] [CommRing R]
    [Algebra M S] [Algebra M R] :
    let TS := S ⊗[M] R
    letI : Algebra M TS := Algebra.TensorProduct.instAlgebra
    letI : Algebra S TS := Algebra.TensorProduct.leftAlgebra
    letI : Algebra R TS :=
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := M) (A := S) (B := R)).toRingHom.toAlgebra
    letI : IsScalarTower M S TS := by
      apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
      rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.algebraMap_def, Algebra.TensorProduct.algebraMap_def,
        RingHom.comp_assoc, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq]
    letI : IsScalarTower M R TS := by
      apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
      ext r
      change (algebraMap M S r) ⊗ₜ[M] (1 : R) =
        (1 : S) ⊗ₜ[M] (algebraMap M R r)
      exact Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_one_eq_one_tmul r
    let hpush : Algebra.IsPushout M R S TS := TensorProduct.isPushout'
    letI : Algebra.IsPushout M S R TS :=
      (Algebra.IsPushout.comm M S R TS).mpr hpush
    (Algebra.IsPushout.equiv M S R TS).toAlgHom = AlgHom.id S TS := by
  dsimp only
  let TS := S ⊗[M] R
  letI : Algebra M TS := Algebra.TensorProduct.instAlgebra
  letI : Algebra S TS := Algebra.TensorProduct.leftAlgebra
  letI : Algebra R TS :=
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := M) (A := S) (B := R)).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  letI : IsScalarTower M S TS := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.algebraMap_def, Algebra.TensorProduct.algebraMap_def,
      RingHom.comp_assoc, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq]
  letI : IsScalarTower M R TS := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
    ext r
    change (algebraMap M S r) ⊗ₜ[M] (1 : R) =
      (1 : S) ⊗ₜ[M] (algebraMap M R r)
    exact Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_one_eq_one_tmul r
  let hpush : Algebra.IsPushout M R S TS := TensorProduct.isPushout'
  letI : Algebra.IsPushout M S R TS :=
    (Algebra.IsPushout.comm M S R TS).mpr hpush
  apply DFunLike.ext _ _
  intro z
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]
  | tmul s r =>
      change (Algebra.IsPushout.equiv M S R TS) (s ⊗ₜ[M] r) = s ⊗ₜ[M] r
      rw [Algebra.IsPushout.equiv_tmul]
      change (s ⊗ₜ[M] (1 : R)) * ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ[M] r) = s ⊗ₜ[M] r
      rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul]
      simp

set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 100000 in
set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 16 in
private theorem etaleCoverPushoutCarrierEquiv_self_naturality
    {M S R : Type u} [CommRing M] [CommRing S] [CommRing R]
    [Algebra M S] [Algebra M R]
    (E : Algebra.EtaleCover R) :
    let TS := S ⊗[M] R
    letI : Algebra M TS := Algebra.TensorProduct.instAlgebra
    letI : Algebra S TS := Algebra.TensorProduct.leftAlgebra
    letI : Algebra R TS :=
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := M) (A := S) (B := R)).toRingHom.toAlgebra
    letI : IsScalarTower M S TS := by
      apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
      rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.algebraMap_def, Algebra.TensorProduct.algebraMap_def,
        RingHom.comp_assoc, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq]
    letI : IsScalarTower M R TS := by
      apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
      ext r
      change (algebraMap M S r) ⊗ₜ[M] (1 : R) =
        (1 : S) ⊗ₜ[M] (algebraMap M R r)
      exact Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_one_eq_one_tmul r
    let hpush : Algebra.IsPushout M R S TS := TensorProduct.isPushout'
    letI : Algebra.IsPushout M S R TS :=
      (Algebra.IsPushout.comm M S R TS).mpr hpush
    let f : R →ₐ[M] E.Carrier :=
      (Algebra.ofId R E.Carrier).restrictScalars M
    let cS : (E.baseChange TS).Carrier ≃ₐ[S] S ⊗[M] E.Carrier :=
      DatG0.etaleCoverPushoutCarrierEquiv (M := M) (S := S) (T := TS) E
    let gS : TS →ₐ[S] (E.baseChange TS).Carrier :=
      (Algebra.ofId TS (E.baseChange TS).Carrier).restrictScalars S
    cS.toAlgHom.comp gS =
      AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom (R := M) (K := S) f := by
  dsimp only
  let TS := S ⊗[M] R
  letI : Algebra M TS := Algebra.TensorProduct.instAlgebra
  letI : Algebra S TS := Algebra.TensorProduct.leftAlgebra
  letI : Algebra R TS :=
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := M) (A := S) (B := R)).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  letI : IsScalarTower M S TS := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.algebraMap_def, Algebra.TensorProduct.algebraMap_def,
      RingHom.comp_assoc, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq]
  letI : IsScalarTower M R TS := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
    ext r
    change (algebraMap M S r) ⊗ₜ[M] (1 : R) =
      (1 : S) ⊗ₜ[M] (algebraMap M R r)
    exact Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_one_eq_one_tmul r
  let hpush : Algebra.IsPushout M R S TS := TensorProduct.isPushout'
  letI : Algebra.IsPushout M S R TS :=
    (Algebra.IsPushout.comm M S R TS).mpr hpush
  let f : R →ₐ[M] E.Carrier :=
    (Algebra.ofId R E.Carrier).restrictScalars M
  let cS : (E.baseChange TS).Carrier ≃ₐ[S] S ⊗[M] E.Carrier :=
    DatG0.etaleCoverPushoutCarrierEquiv (M := M) (S := S) (T := TS) E
  let gS : TS →ₐ[S] (E.baseChange TS).Carrier :=
    (Algebra.ofId TS (E.baseChange TS).Carrier).restrictScalars S
  let fS := AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom (R := M) (K := S) f
  have hnat := DatG0.etaleCoverPushoutCarrierEquiv_symm_naturality
    (M := M) (S := S) (R := R) (T := TS) E
  change cS.symm.toAlgHom.comp fS =
    gS.comp (Algebra.IsPushout.equiv M S R TS).toAlgHom at hnat
  rw [tensorProductPushoutEquiv_self] at hnat
  rw [AlgHom.comp_id] at hnat
  rw [← hnat, ← AlgHom.comp_assoc]
  have hc : cS.toAlgHom.comp cS.symm.toAlgHom =
      AlgHom.id S (S ⊗[M] E.Carrier) := by
    apply DFunLike.ext _ _
    intro x
    exact cS.apply_symm_apply x
  rw [hc, AlgHom.id_comp]

namespace PicEtAff

set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 100000 in
set_option maxHeartbeats 2400000 in
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 16 in
/-- Mapping the class descended to a nested finite tensor stage back to the ambient tensor
algebra recovers its original etale-plus Picard class. -/
theorem mapAlg_mk_descentClassOfTensorStageData
    {F K B : Type u} [Field F] [Field K] [Algebra F K]
    [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F K] [CommRing B] [Algebra F B]
    (M : DatG0.FinSubext F K)
    {C : Over (Spec (.of M.1))} (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 M.1) [IsAffineHom pi]
    [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    [GeometricallyReduced C.hom] :
    let R := M.1 ⊗[F] B
    let TK := K ⊗[F] B
    let iota : R →ₐ[F] TK :=
      Algebra.TensorProduct.map M.1.val (AlgHom.id F B)
    letI : Algebra R TK := iota.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    letI : IsScalarTower F M.1 TK := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
    ∀ (E₀ : Algebra.EtaleCover R)
      (ξK : descentClasses C (E₀.baseChange TK))
      (D : RelPicTensorStageData pi
        (relPicAlgMap C
          ((DatG0.etaleCoverTensorStageCarrierEquiv M E₀).toAlgHom.restrictScalars M.1)
          ξK)),
      let TS := D.stage.stage ⊗[M.1] R
      letI : Algebra R TS := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
      mapAlg C (DatG0.tensorStageNestedAmbientMapOverIntermediate M D.stage)
          (mk C (E₀.baseChange TS)
            (descentClassOfTensorStageData M pi E₀ ξK D)) =
        mk C (E₀.baseChange TK) ξK := by
  dsimp only
  let iota : M.1 ⊗[F] B →ₐ[F] K ⊗[F] B :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.map M.1.val (AlgHom.id F B)
  letI : Algebra (M.1 ⊗[F] B) (K ⊗[F] B) :=
    iota.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  letI : IsScalarTower F M.1 (K ⊗[F] B) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  intro E₀ ξK D
  let R := M.1 ⊗[F] B
  let TK := K ⊗[F] B
  let S := D.stage.stage
  let TS := S ⊗[M.1] R
  letI : Algebra R TS := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  let f : R →ₐ[M.1] E₀.Carrier :=
    (Algebra.ofId R E₀.Carrier).restrictScalars M.1
  let cS : (E₀.baseChange TS).Carrier ≃ₐ[S] S ⊗[M.1] E₀.Carrier :=
    DatG0.etaleCoverPushoutCarrierEquiv (M := M.1) (S := S) (T := TS) E₀
  let cK : (E₀.baseChange TK).Carrier ≃ₐ[K] K ⊗[M.1] E₀.Carrier :=
    DatG0.etaleCoverTensorStageCarrierEquiv M E₀
  let nS : S ⊗[M.1] E₀.Carrier →ₐ[M.1] K ⊗[M.1] E₀.Carrier :=
    D.stage.tensorMap (A := E₀.Carrier)
  let cSM := cS.toAlgHom.restrictScalars M.1
  let cSInvM := cS.symm.toAlgHom.restrictScalars M.1
  let cKInvM := cK.symm.toAlgHom.restrictScalars M.1
  let n : (E₀.baseChange TS).Carrier →ₐ[M.1] (E₀.baseChange TK).Carrier :=
    cKInvM.comp (nS.comp cSM)
  let φ : TS →ₐ[M.1] TK :=
    DatG0.tensorStageNestedAmbientMapOverIntermediate M D.stage
  apply mapAlg_mk_eq_mk C φ (E₀.baseChange TS) (E₀.baseChange TK)
    (descentClassOfTensorStageData M pi E₀ ξK D) ξK n
  · intro a
    let gS : TS →ₐ[M.1] (E₀.baseChange TS).Carrier :=
      (Algebra.ofId TS (E₀.baseChange TS).Carrier).restrictScalars M.1
    let gK : TK →ₐ[M.1] (E₀.baseChange TK).Carrier :=
      (Algebra.ofId TK (E₀.baseChange TK).Carrier).restrictScalars M.1
    let fS : S ⊗[M.1] R →ₐ[M.1] S ⊗[M.1] E₀.Carrier :=
      (AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
        (R := M.1) (K := S) f).restrictScalars M.1
    let fK : K ⊗[M.1] R →ₐ[M.1] K ⊗[M.1] E₀.Carrier :=
      (AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
        (R := M.1) (K := K) f).restrictScalars M.1
    let nR : S ⊗[M.1] R →ₐ[M.1] K ⊗[M.1] R :=
      D.stage.tensorMap (A := R)
    let eK : K ⊗[M.1] R ≃ₐ[K] TK :=
      DatG0.etaleCoverTensorStageBaseEquiv (F := F) (K := K) (B := B) M
    let eKM := eK.toAlgHom.restrictScalars M.1
    have hS0 := etaleCoverPushoutCarrierEquiv_self_naturality
      (M := M.1) (S := S) (R := R) E₀
    have hS : cSM.comp gS = fS := by
      exact congrArg (fun h => h.restrictScalars M.1) hS0
    have hTower : nS.comp fS = fK.comp nR := by
      have h := AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom_tower f
      simpa only [nS, nR, fS, fK, DatG0.FiniteStageData.tensorMap] using h
    have hK0 := DatG0.etaleCoverTensorStageCarrierEquiv_symm_naturality M E₀
    have hK : cKInvM.comp fK = gK.comp eKM := by
      exact congrArg (fun h => h.restrictScalars M.1) hK0
    have hnaturality : n.comp gS = gK.comp φ := by
      change (cKInvM.comp (nS.comp cSM)).comp gS = gK.comp (eKM.comp nR)
      rw [AlgHom.comp_assoc, AlgHom.comp_assoc, hS, ← AlgHom.comp_assoc, hTower,
        AlgHom.comp_assoc, hK, AlgHom.comp_assoc]
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun hnaturality a
  · let ξS := descentClassOfTensorStageData M pi E₀ ξK D
    have hξS : (ξS : relPic C (overSpec M.1 (E₀.baseChange TS).Carrier)) =
        relPicAlgMap C cSInvM D.qStage := by
      rfl
    rw [hξS, ← relPicAlgMap_comp]
    have hcS : cSM.comp cSInvM =
        AlgHom.id M.1 (S ⊗[M.1] E₀.Carrier) := by
      apply DFunLike.ext _ _
      intro x
      exact cS.apply_symm_apply x
    have hn : n.comp cSInvM =
        tensorStageDataCarrierMap M E₀ D.stage := by
      change (cKInvM.comp (nS.comp cSM)).comp cSInvM =
        cKInvM.comp nS
      rw [AlgHom.comp_assoc, AlgHom.comp_assoc, hcS, AlgHom.id_comp]
    rw [hn]
    exact tensorStageData_map_eq M pi E₀ ξK D

set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 100000 in
set_option maxHeartbeats 2400000 in
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 16 in
/-- The outer-field form of
`mapAlg_mk_descentClassOfTensorStageData`: after the finite-stage class is transported to
the intermediate curve, the inverse base-field shuffle returns it to the original curve. -/
theorem mapAlg_mk_descentClassOfTensorStageData_baseFieldShuffle
    {F K B : Type u} [Field F] [Field K] [Algebra F K]
    [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F K] [CommRing B] [Algebra F B]
    (M : DatG0.FinSubext F K)
    {C : Over (Spec (.of F))}
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    (pi : ((baseChange F M.1).obj C).left ⟶ P1 M.1) [IsAffineHom pi] :
    let R := M.1 ⊗[F] B
    let TK := K ⊗[F] B
    let iota : R →ₐ[F] TK :=
      Algebra.TensorProduct.map M.1.val (AlgHom.id F B)
    letI : Algebra R TK := iota.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    ∀ (E₀ : Algebra.EtaleCover R)
      (ξK : descentClasses C (E₀.baseChange TK))
      (ξM : descentClasses ((baseChange F M.1).obj C) (E₀.baseChange TK))
      (hξM : ξM =
        (crossBaseTransportFamily F M.1 C).descentHom (E₀.baseChange TK) ξK)
      (D : RelPicTensorStageData pi
        (relPicAlgMap ((baseChange F M.1).obj C)
          ((DatG0.etaleCoverTensorStageCarrierEquiv M E₀).toAlgHom.restrictScalars M.1)
          ξM)),
      let TS := D.stage.stage ⊗[M.1] R
      letI : Algebra R TS := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
      letI : Algebra F TS := Algebra.compHom TS (algebraMap F M.1)
      letI : IsScalarTower F M.1 TS := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
      mapAlg C (DatG0.tensorStageNestedAmbientMap M D.stage)
        ((baseFieldShuffle F M.1 C TS).symm
          (mk ((baseChange F M.1).obj C) (E₀.baseChange TS)
            (descentClassOfTensorStageData M pi E₀ ξM D))) =
        mk C (E₀.baseChange TK) ξK := by
  dsimp only
  let iota : M.1 ⊗[F] B →ₐ[F] K ⊗[F] B :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.map M.1.val (AlgHom.id F B)
  letI : Algebra (M.1 ⊗[F] B) (K ⊗[F] B) :=
    iota.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  intro E₀ ξK ξM hξM D
  let R := M.1 ⊗[F] B
  let TK := K ⊗[F] B
  let S := D.stage.stage
  let TS := S ⊗[M.1] R
  letI : Algebra R TS := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  letI : Algebra F TS := Algebra.compHom TS (algebraMap F M.1)
  letI : IsScalarTower F M.1 TS := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let CM := (baseChange F M.1).obj C
  let φM : TS →ₐ[M.1] TK :=
    DatG0.tensorStageNestedAmbientMapOverIntermediate M D.stage
  let yM : PicEtAff CM TS :=
    mk CM (E₀.baseChange TS)
      (descentClassOfTensorStageData M pi E₀ ξM D)
  have hcore : mapAlg CM φM yM =
      mk CM (E₀.baseChange TK) ξM := by
    exact mapAlg_mk_descentClassOfTensorStageData
      (M := M) (C := CM) pi E₀ ξM D
  have hrestrict : φM.restrictScalars F =
      DatG0.tensorStageNestedAmbientMap M D.stage := by
    apply DFunLike.ext _ _
    intro z
    rfl
  have hshuffle :
      (baseFieldShuffle F M.1 C TK).symm (mapAlg CM φM yM) =
        mapAlg C (φM.restrictScalars F)
          ((baseFieldShuffle F M.1 C TS).symm yM) := by
    exact mapAlg_baseFieldShuffle_symm F M.1 C φM yM
  have hback :
      (baseFieldShuffle F M.1 C TK).symm
          (mk CM (E₀.baseChange TK) ξM) =
        mk C (E₀.baseChange TK) ξK := by
    calc
      (baseFieldShuffle F M.1 C TK).symm
          (mk CM (E₀.baseChange TK) ξM) =
          (baseFieldShuffle F M.1 C TK).symm
            (mk CM (E₀.baseChange TK)
              ((crossBaseTransportFamily F M.1 C).descentHom
                (E₀.baseChange TK) ξK)) := by rw [hξM]
      _ = (baseFieldShuffle F M.1 C TK).symm
          (baseFieldShuffle F M.1 C TK
            (mk C (E₀.baseChange TK) ξK)) := by
          rw [baseFieldShuffle_mk]
      _ = mk C (E₀.baseChange TK) ξK :=
        (baseFieldShuffle F M.1 C TK).symm_apply_apply _
  calc
    mapAlg C (DatG0.tensorStageNestedAmbientMap M D.stage)
        ((baseFieldShuffle F M.1 C TS).symm yM) =
      mapAlg C (φM.restrictScalars F)
        ((baseFieldShuffle F M.1 C TS).symm yM) := by rw [hrestrict]
    _ = (baseFieldShuffle F M.1 C TK).symm (mapAlg CM φM yM) :=
      hshuffle.symm
    _ = (baseFieldShuffle F M.1 C TK).symm
        (mk CM (E₀.baseChange TK) ξM) := by rw [hcore]
    _ = mk C (E₀.baseChange TK) ξK := hback

end PicEtAff

end
